content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Music online

Sovereign commerce infrastructure refers to the use of decentralized technologies to facilitate online transactions, allowing creators to maintain ownership and control over their sales. This approach is crucial for digital creators in regions where traditional payment platforms are unavailable or restricted. By leveraging blockchain technology and cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin, creators can ensure seamless and secure transactions, thereby expanding their reach and customer base.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of sovereign commerce infrastructure typically involves a combination of free and paid tools, including hosting services like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, backend logic providers like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and payment processing systems like NOWPayments. These components work together to enable automatic crypto payment verification, instant product delivery, and full data ownership, providing a comprehensive solution for digital creators.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators who face restrictions in using traditional payment platforms. It caters to those who sell digital products like ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software, and need a reliable and secure way to accept payments. By providing an alternative to conventional payment systems, sovereign commerce infrastructure helps creators in regions like Kenya to overcome financial isolation and reach a global audience.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure empowers creators to take control of their sales.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of sovereign commerce infrastructure include hosting services, backend logic providers, payment processing systems, and storage solutions. For instance, NOWPayments enables automatic on-chain crypto payment verification with a 0.5% fee, while GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages offer free hosting options. Additionally, Cloudflare Workers and Google Apps Script provide backend logic, and Supabase or Google Sheets serve as order storage solutions, ensuring a seamless and integrated experience for creators.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy sovereign commerce infrastructure, creators can start by selecting the necessary components and tools. They can choose from various hosting services, backend logic providers, and payment processing systems, depending on their specific needs. By following a step-by-step guide and leveraging pre-built templates and blueprints, creators can quickly set up their own infrastructure and start accepting Bitcoin payments, thereby taking control of their online sales and revenue.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
NOWPayments enables secure and reliable transactions with a 0.5% fee.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy the complete stack under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything you need to build it yourself. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
